summary: Package offer 'perfil completo + 3 tarjetas' tested end-to-end. Backend: the qa_package_flow.sh regression matches every expected echo line. New pytest test_packages_flow.py: 5/6 pass (cash flow with card ownership checked by card ids, hidden draft cards, US Stripe checkout staying processing then pending on cancel, permissions/reassign). One failure: after a link is regenerated, the old token returns 404 'invalid' instead of 410. Frontend: advisor flow (settings link, /asesores, autosave, editor ?package= save-and-return, finalize CO cash, delivery card with QR/copy/download, cash section, no overflow at 390px), client claim flow (preview, login?next, review, diff, handle gating, cash pending, activated, 3 cards in Perfil > Tarjetas) and /website ES/EN copy all work. BUG: the static /servicios/tarjeta-bruno/ page was not updated. Its title and body still describe a single card, and the EN title renders 'undefined'.

minor.issue: Regenerating replaces claim_token_hash, so GET /api/packages/claim/{oldToken} returns 404 {state:'invalid'} instead of the required 410 {state:'revoked'}. The revoke_only path correctly returns 410. Fix: keep a list of previous token hashes (e.g. revoked_token_hashes) and have _resolve return 410 revoked for them.

The script counts cards with c.get('package_id') from GET /api/cards, but that response strips package_id, so it always prints 0 and the '(3)' check after activation is meaningless. It should compare card ids instead (pytest does this and passes).
The plaintext claim_url (containing the token) is stored next to claim_token_hash, which defeats hashing the token. Low risk (only advisor/admin views return it), but worth noting.

ui_bugs.issue: index.html was not updated. <title> is still 'BRUNO × OVC — Tu mundo, en una tarjeta digital', the meta description is old, and the body still says 'Esta oferta incluye una tarjeta digital, su enlace y un QR digital'. locale.js has the new ES keys ('Tu perfil completo + 3 tarjetas digitales', etc.) but no matching text nodes exist in index.html, so they never render. In EN, render() sets document.title = dict['BRUNO × OVC — Tu mundo, en una tarjeta digital'], a key that no longer exists, so the browser title is 'undefined'.

issues: The status pill still shows 'Pending acceptance' after the client accepted, because delivery_status stays pending_acceptance until activation. Consider showing 'Accepted · awaiting payment' when accepted is true.
Market/method selects truncate their labels at desktop width ('Colombia · COP $', 'Virtual (Stripe / W').
History shows raw user UUIDs ('by: 720cfd5d-...') instead of handles.
At 390px the expiry text next to Regenerar/Revocar enlace wraps into a very narrow column.
Briefly renders 'Sesión: @ ·' with an empty handle before access loads.
The hero still reads 'Get mine for US$30', '$30 Your card. One payment.' and 'Link + QR · One revision included' (single-card wording), while the service/pricing section shows the new offer.

action_items: Update /app/frontend/public/servicios/tarjeta-bruno/index.html: title, meta description and body copy to 'perfil completo + 3 tarjetas digitales'. Fix the document.title lookup in locale.js render(), which shows 'undefined' in EN.
Return 410 {state:'revoked'} for tokens replaced by regenerate (store previous hashes).
Fix qa_package_flow.sh card checks to compare card ids, since package_id is stripped from GET /api/cards.
Optional UX: claim status pill after accept, select label truncation, show handles instead of UUIDs in history, update the website hero copy to the new offer.
critical_code_review_comments: regenerate_link overwrites claim_token_hash, so old links become 'invalid' (404) rather than 'revoked' (410).
_resolve compares ISO strings for expiry. This works only while every timestamp uses the same tz-aware isoformat.
The finalize handle check for admins compares against p.advisor_handle and then bypasses it anyway (dead branch). Harmless.
claim_url is persisted in plaintext alongside the token hash.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (advisor and client flows 100%; static service page copy/title broken)
